# WeGoForward

> WeGoForward sets up a website assistant for independent repair shops. It answers approved questions and drafts follow-up for a person to send. Gunnison Valley, Colorado.

## Services

- [Website answers](https://wegoforward.app/services): $495 setup + $99/month. About 15 approved questions for an independent repair shop. Anything else goes to a person. One update a month. It never sends, books, or spends on its own. Records stay in your accounts. Questions go to the AI provider named in your quote.
- [Lead follow-up](https://wegoforward.app/services): $995 setup + $249/month. Website answers, plus the enquiry lands in your sheet or inbox and a draft waits for a person to send it. A weekly note on what came in.

## Pricing

- [Website answers](https://wegoforward.app/pricing): $495 setup + $99/month. About 15 approved questions. Hands everything else to a person. One update a month. Records stay in your accounts; questions go to the AI provider named in your quote.
- [Lead follow-up](https://wegoforward.app/pricing): $995 setup + $249/month. Everything in website answers, plus follow-up. Leads saved to your own sheet or inbox. Draft replies a person sends. Weekly note on what came in.
- [Pricing](https://wegoforward.app/pricing): Website answers is $495 setup + $99/month. Lead follow-up is $995 setup + $249/month. These two prices are starting points. A written quote finalizes the scope and the price before any work. Payment terms are set out in that quote. This page lists no other price and no intro discount.

## Contact

- [Contact](https://wegoforward.app/contact): Book a free 20-minute call about the repair-shop website assistant. Tell me how your shop handles questions and follow-up. Send your name, shop, email, and a question. A reply window is not published on this page yet. LinkedIn is there if the form cannot send. There is no newsletter. Local to the Gunnison Valley or Crested Butte? I am happy to meet in person. What not to send: passwords, Social Security numbers or account numbers. I will never ask for them by message.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wegoforward.app/): A website assistant that answers, then waits. WeGoForward sets up one assistant for an independent repair shop. It answers the questions you approve and drafts follow-up for a person to send. It never sends, books, or spends on its own. Book a free 20-minute call. Based in the Gunnison Valley, Colorado. This site sets no cookies and has no ads. The contact page has one short form. Cloudflare counts visits without cookies. WeGoForward is not a law firm, accounting firm or insurer, and nothing here is legal advice.
